_freeze_note: Canonical SHA is computed after stripping underscore-prefixed keys, with json.dumps(sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'),ensure_ascii=True), matching the TLGP frozen-design scheme.

budget.lr_selection: validation balanced accuracy max; selected checkpoint is best validation epoch

claim_ceiling: Rung1 seen-rule capacity-vs-architecture diagnostic only, and only among capacities that demonstrate trainability under the frozen recipe. No rung3, transfer, H0, H1, mechanism, agency, self, AGI, EGO, runtime, companion, or mainline claim.

decision_rules.H_arch_legit: all relevant capacities are trainability-admissible and bp is flat/non-increasing; route architecture_limited_over_swept_range
decision_rules.H_cap: bp increases across ADMISSIBLE trained capacities; route reopen_rung3_powered_after_powered_rung1_confirm
decision_rules.INCONCLUSIVE_optimization: any larger capacity fails trainability under this recipe; route optimization_unresolved_recipe_or_scale; not an architecture claim
decision_rules.inadmissible: leakage invalid, fair saturation on a claimed clear, ablation non-collapse on a claimed clear, replay mismatch, protected-source mismatch, C0 anchor miss, or trainability failure blocks architecture interpretation

phase2.eval: held-out episode evaluation on selected seen train-pool rules; 172 uses exact rung1 task

rule_subset.selection: deterministic no-replacement subsample of k TRAIN-pool rules for k<172

recipe.weight_decay_scope: 2D weight matrices only; no decay on biases, LayerNorm, or 1D params

trainability_control.failure_interpretation: INVALID optimization/untrained capacity; exclude from breakpoint map and do not read as architecture-limited

wall_clock.review_note: Claude sets any cap after dry-run review; null means no cap is frozen for this dry-run authoring step.
